Name: Sweet Talking Sam Gives Rare Items
Author: Kagurahime
Description:
Simply unzip the file and drop it into your stardew valley folder. It will replace 1 file.
<br />
<br />From then on your hubby, Sam will give you a randomly selected rare item almost every morning.
<br />
<br />Sam will also sweet talk you and say more diverse things.
<br />
<br />Have fun!

Downloads.Description: Makes your hubby give expensive gifts and say sweet things
